In March, the total value added of industrial enterprises above the designated size increased by 5.7% year on year in real terms (the growth rates of value added are the real growth rates after deducting price factors). On a month-on-month basis, the value added of industrial enterprises above the designated size in March increased by 0.44%.

From January to March, the total value added of industrial enterprises above the designated size went up by 5.8% year on year.
